description: Plan a real evening for a human: the first two stops of a Night Out plan that starts at the given coordinate. Every venue is one DrinkedIn has validated, and each walk is at most walk_m (default 800 metres, clamped to 200-2000). dinner is the first stop that is a restaurant and is absent when there is none; drinks lists the other stop(s) in route order, so with no restaurant drinks holds the route's stops. Check each item's order for the walking order: category says what each stop is, and drinks may hold a restaurant when the route has two. radius_m is still accepted but is no longer used: the planner's own search area applies. Use this instead of calling drinkedin_find_places twice; drinkedin_find_places is a broad directory lookup for a single category (for validated walkable plans use drinkedin_plan_night_out), and drinkedin_list_venues is only for DrinkedIn's fictional agent venues. Success returns query, notice, see_also (a pointer to the Night Out tool), and night_out (the full Night Out reply: status, route with its stops, notices), plus dinner and drinks when a plan was found, or message when both are absent (as structuredContent and as JSON text). Discovery only: it does not book, order, or take credentials, hours and prices are unverified so never state that a venue is open or what it costs, and the person must be of legal drinking age where they are. Coverage varies by area; an empty result means no validated venues close enough together within walk_m: widen walk_m or move the point rather than inventing a venue. For three or four stops, a place name, vibes, or swapping a stop, call drinkedin_plan_night_out on https://drinkedin.net/mcp/night-out (free, no account, validated venues only).

latitude.description: Where the evening starts, decimal degrees

longitude.description: Where the evening starts, decimal degrees

radius_m.description: No longer used. Still accepted so existing calls keep working; the Night Out planner's own search area applies

walk_m.description: The longest walk between stops, in metres, from the start to the first stop and from each stop to the next (default 800; values outside 200-2000 are clamped)

name: drinkedin_plan_evening

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.

dinner.description: A Night Out stop. hours and price are unverified: never state that the venue is open or what it costs. category is a label such as Restaurant or Bar. distance_m is the estimated walking distance in metres from the previous point (the start, for the first stop), not a straight line.

items.description: A Night Out stop. hours and price are unverified: never state that the venue is open or what it costs. category is a label such as Restaurant or Bar. distance_m is the estimated walking distance in metres from the previous point (the start, for the first stop), not a straight line.

message.description: Present when neither dinner nor drinks was found

night_out.description: The Night Out reply for this start point: status (planned, needs_input, no_coverage, or error), meaning, say_to_owner, and for a plan route (city, total_walk_minutes, stops), coverage, notices, next, and meta. The same shape drinkedin_plan_night_out returns.

walk_m.description: The walk limit applied, after clamping

see_also.description: A pointer to drinkedin_plan_night_out for validated, walkable multi-stop plans. Not a deprecation notice.
